1.explanation: To reproduce and fix the positioning issue, you need to see: (1) how the CodeSnippet SCSS (code-snippet.scss) applies absolute positioning for the copy button in single mode, (2) how the CodeSnippet React component (CodeSnippet.js) renders the CopyButton inside its wrapper, and (3) how the CopyButton SCSS (copy-button.scss) and its component (CopyButton.js) default to relative positioning. The index.js files show how these modules are composed and imported, so you can trace CSS specificity and import order effects on the final style.
1.bug_scenario: In “single” mode the CodeSnippet component renders a CopyButton inside the snippet container, but the copy icon button (with class .bx--copy-btn) is appearing in the top‐left rather than the top‐right as expected. The SCSS for .bx--copy-btn is setting position: relative, overriding the snippet’s absolute positioning (which should anchor it to the top corner). Key UI elements involved are the CodeSnippet container, the copy icon button, and their respective SCSS position declarations.
